svg.title: quorum v2 on an ATECC608C: the config zone, sixteen data slots and the OTP zone, and who writes each
svg.text: PicoQuorum's chip configuration for a branded key (proposed)
128 bytes: what every slot may do
B6: locked with a CRC, brand inside
Sign external only · no internal sign, no ECDH · PrivWrite never · public key readable · counter 0 counts every use · sealed by your U4
The brand record, version 2. No key fields: there is no key yet when the bench writes it.
